explanation: Aluminium powder reduces manganese dioxide to molten manganese metal in a highly exothermic displacement reaction — the same aluminothermic principle as the thermite reaction, just with a different metal oxide.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A mixed grey-black powder of manganese dioxide and silvery aluminium.
beaker_view.final_appearance: A glowing pool of molten manganese, alongside solid white aluminium oxide.

thermal.visual_cue: Burns with intense heat, producing molten manganese metal, much like the iron thermite reaction.

beaker_view.observation: Once ignited, the mixture reacts with intense heat, producing a glowing pool of molten manganese — essentially the same spectacle as the classic iron thermite reaction.
